title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7764: guarded equivariant Frobenius-class walk, quotient in the report filter, the inversion-free six-column route proved impossible

claims.statement: For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.39, and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7764 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12, p^6 = -1 (mod r). One step computes the twelve class keys of the state y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the distinguished-point predicate and by the table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded table entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) = g^{u_t p^{-col}} with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r (five of every eight), where col equals kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps of this trail, in which case the column recorded then is reused. That routing guard is the mechanism that removes the absorbing family: p^6 = -1 makes TBL[t][k+6] the inverse of TBL[t][k], so without the guard a multiply step landing on kappa+6 in the same row returns the state exactly with both labels cancelling, an equation-free cycle at 1/(12R) per step which no walk of 2^125 steps can survive. With the guard, every two visits to one table row inside a cycle of length at most 2D+1 = 25 are at cyclic distance at most D, so the second visit reuses the first visit's column and that row contributes #visits * u_t * p^{-k} with 0 < #visits <= 25 < r, which is never 0 mod r; hence no absorbing all-multiplier cycle of length at most 25 exists, including the two-cycle, the {k,k+4,k+8} three-cycle and the a,b,a,b four-cycle. Longer cycles need at least L/2 row coincidences with matching twelfth-root relations, rate at most (1/(12R))^(L/2) <= 2^-228.6 per step window, i.e. 2^-102.8 over the whole walk, and a cycle containing a squaring step closes only if (1-2^s)v = B with 1-2^s different from 0, at most one element per cyclic pattern, at most 2^-129 over the walk. The guard is sigma-covariant because it reads (row, column) pairs, both of which shift by the same Frobenius power, so the successor class remains a function of the class: 0 of 768 element-level equivariance checks split, against 462 of 768 and 704 of 768 for the two control rules. A separate exhaustive enumeration of all 4096 subsets of the twelve column exponents shows that the only subsets closed under the routing action k -> k+1 are the empty set and the full set, that the full set contains the inverse pairs {k,k+6}, and that the lower-half six-column set is inversion-free but not closed (on it kappa and kappa+6 select the same column, forcing m^2 = 1 on every entry, impossible for a nonidentity element of odd order); therefore no nonempty sigma-stable inversion-free column table exists and the guard is the shipped mechanism by necessity. The guard is per trail, so two trails that meet at a common class can disagree while their rings differ; they reconcile within D steps, and a merge survives that window with probability at least 1 - 2*D^2/R = 1 - 288/16384 = 0.982421875, which is charged against the success target. Per-step cost in counted instructions: a 21921-instruction multiply step and a 13445-instruction squaring step, made of the dense Fp12 multiply 20000, a 1613-instruction twelve-key selector on every step, a 48-instruction guard on the multiply channel, a 16-instruction column address, a 72-instruction table fetch, a 28-instruction label add, a 72-instruction key mix and the Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring at its itemised 11632; the sigma-on-state, label-renormalisation and escape rows are all zero by construction, and the twelve pre-expanded table columns are charged once at 2^20.585 reference units. The squaring share is ONE number, the routing share f = 3/8, used for the step price, for the step budget S and for the success model; S is the least integer with S^2(1-f^2) >= 2*mu*N*ln(1/(1-0.3990139)) at mu = 11/10, giving log2 S = 125.827264; c_raw = 0.937125 and c_stress = 0.9653325 with every judgement-bounded fold row repriced at 13/10, giving W_raw = 2^125.733578 and W_stress = 2^125.776362; the claim 125.7764 is the least four-decimal log2 value above log2(W_stress) + 2e-5. Success is the analytic birthday expression Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2*mu*N) = 0.5091835003, giving 1-exp(-Lambda) = 0.3990139, and 0.3920000 net of the merge-stickiness retention 0.982421875, against the 0.39 floor. Records are 112 bytes (48-byte class key plus two full 32-byte exponent limbs) in one shared store; each trail starts from a fresh uniform label pair and ends at its first distinguished point of mean 2^80 steps, the reporting trail is replaced by a fresh one so that starts equal reports (62428245287538), and no live trail is ever restarted, aborted or re-seeded. Peak storage is 6991963585455328 bytes over store, labels, advice and scratch. A repeated class key solves by trying x = (p^j a2 - a1)/(b1 - p^j b2) for j = 0..11 and VERIFYING each candidate by exponentiation against z, so a wrong shift costs a verification and never a wrong answer; j = 6 is the involution case x = -(a1+a2)/(b1+b2). Identifiability of the involution with a shift is not used to reduce the class count: sigma^6 = -1 lies in the subgroup generated by sigma, so the mu6 quotient IS the sigma quotient and no DP-density doubling is claimed. The shipped evidence is a real-tower toy executing the same guarded step: an exhaustive return-lag ladder over all 9420 fixture elements with no return at any lag 2..26 at the shipped depth against first returns at lags 6, 4 and 2 for depths 2, 1 and 0, an exact joint-space cycle census over 913741 (element, ring) states with zero two-cycles and zero three-cycles against 24 two-cycles for the guard-free rule, 768/768 element-level equivariance checks with zero splits, 0/384 coalescence splits from independent same-class starts against 349/384 for the control, 256/256 exact inverse pairs with 32/32 label-bit solves verified and 0/32 for the sign-flipped control, 144/144 end-to-end solves across all twelve shifts with exactly one verified candidate each and zero zero-denominators, and 24/24 checks on BLS12-381 itself including a real pairing evaluation of a planted instance. The census at 6400 trials per density recovers 0.7316 at 2^-5 (CP-95 lower 0.722296) and 0.5262 at 2^-7 (CP-95 lower 0.515898) with every collision solved and verified and zero invariant, attribution or zero-denominator failures; those fixture rates are disclosed as fixture-scale because the toy table has 64 rows against production 2^14 and the fixture is cycle-dominated, so they measure the merge-solve-verify mechanism and its density trend rather than a production recovery rate. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: the class walk behaves as a random map to within the carried 10 per cent inefficiency allowance, the routing fields derived from the class key are pseudorandom, and the algorithm's coins are ideal. No production run, no unconditional success theorem, no novelty claim and no practical break is claimed.
